result.summary: The page layout is generally consistent, but the header action button appears to be missing its icon, and favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right of the header is empty — it renders as a plain grey circle with only a small red notification dot and no icon (profile/notification glyph is missing). Users cannot tell what the control does.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon (avatar, bell, or profile glyph) inside the circular button and add an accessible label/tooltip describing its action.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the 'Popular right now' restaurant cards are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circle with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon color across all cards (e.g., always a semi-transparent white circle with an outlined heart) so the control looks identical everywhere.
